title: Earthquake McGoon's and the Magic Cellar
summary: Steinau explains how Turk's group bought the club and how a magician's props became the Magic Cellar below it.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I really don't know enough about Turk Murphy to ask you. You know, I've heard the rackets, and I've heard him a lot, but not that often. They ask you much more, unless you can think of something else.

Well, one thing that I found of interest was, was, his difficulty in speaking. Turk has, since I first met him, a stammer, particularly if he's speaking to strangers, but also if he's speaking to people he knows. But he doesn't, I've never heard him stammer once when he sings. And he does vocals quite frequently. And I'm not sure what that signifies, but I've heard some, something like that stated of another, of another musician. I wonder if it has some, I'm sure it has some kind of significance, but I don't know what. I think that's a well-known medical fact. One of many. One of many.
